name: Eagle Beach dusk lights, shallows, and sea grape
geo_source: Esri World Imagery shore and dune along Eagle Beach and Manchebo
ref_sources: Sea grape is the low round bush on the dune between the sand and J.E. Irausquin, placed where the aerial is dark green and clear of the fofoti. A colour sheet in the shallows shadowed the dry sand, so the beach grain and the island water shader stay as they are. Hotel windows sit on the beach face of each resort hero. Boulevard lamps and the palapa-bar strings are emissive glow, the same cheap night read used elsewhere on the map. Existing resort heroes and the fofoti sets are left in place. Original geometry.
